blocks.text: Fintech that understands both sides of the table

EFUNDZZ brings lending domain expertise into Purview’s Finance and Payments vertical, next to T-Wallet and BenePay. It is a working marketplace with lender integrations, credit-decision workflows and document handling that Purview’s engineering keeps secure and scalable.

items.title: Working capital
items.body: Overdrafts and cash-credit lines to run the business.

items.title: Term loans
items.body: Expansion and capex funding with structured repayment.

items.title: Equipment and vehicle finance
items.body: Asset-backed funding for machinery and fleets.

items.title: Loan against property
items.body: Larger tickets secured on commercial or residential property.

items.title: For lenders
items.body: A marketplace of qualified SME borrowers, with digital documentation.

items.title: Check eligibility
items.body: A few business details give an indicative view of what is available.

items.title: Apply once
items.body: One application and one document set, uploaded digitally.

items.title: Get matched
items.body: The marketplace matches the business to lenders whose criteria it meets.

items.title: Compare offers
items.body: Rates, tenure and terms side by side, with a banker available to advise.

items.title: Disburse
items.body: The chosen lender completes diligence and disburses; EFUNDZZ tracks it through.
